svg.title: Driver Dreamer — Straight Wide Bubbles and Thin Wide Weave
svg.desc: Two refinements of the selected Wide Soft Weave: original wide bubbles aligned straight, and wide bubbles with reduced vertical height retaining the weave offsets. Both keep the original car, shield, crown and wordmark. Each appears as an icon and logo with text, with a trail detail, colors and font families.

g.text: Grand Tourer Crest / V6 / Wide bubble refinements
Based on V5 Wide Soft Weave. The original car, shield, crown and wordmark carry forward.
The selected wide bubbles, centered in a straight line.

svg.title: Driver Dreamer — Grand Tourer Straight Wide Bubbles
svg.desc: The original navy Grand Tourer shield, red crown and white front-facing car are retained unchanged. Three filled racing-red wide rounded rectangular thought bubbles rise along a straight vertical centerline beneath the vehicle. The selected Wide Soft Weave bubble widths, heights and rounded corners are preserved.

svg.title: Driver Dreamer — Grand Tourer Straight Wide Bubbles

svg.title: Driver Dreamer — Grand Tourer — Thin Wide Weave
svg.desc: The original navy Grand Tourer shield, red crown and white front-facing car are retained unchanged. Three filled racing-red thought bubbles keep the widths, centers and alternating offsets of Wide Soft Weave, with thinner heights and smoothly rounded ends.
